metadata.title: Multidisciplinary Collaboration in the Performance of Aortic Surgery: A Scientific Statement From the American Heart Association
top_takeaways: Aortic surgery requires continuous, highly coordinated interventions among surgeons, anesthesiologists, and perfusionists, as actions by any single team member can have immediate consequences for others.
Intraoperative management involves complex strategies such as single-lung ventilation, systemic cooling and rewarming, and multi-organ protection (myocardial, cerebral, and visceral).
Effective multidisciplinary collaboration addressing the specific operational concerns of each clinical role is essential for optimizing safety and outcomes in aortic surgery.
